analysis.reasonEn: RSI hovers in the low 60s, hesitating to enter overbought territory. MACD histogram remains negative but shows improvement, signaling weak downside momentum. SMA20 ($83,872.96) and SMA50 ($79,922.64) are acting as support. Trading volume at 0.96x the 5-day average, indicating sideways movement without strong conviction. 4-hour MACD histogram turned negative, suggesting short-term selling pressure. Weekly ADX at 43.9 indicates strong trend, but daily chart lacks clear direction, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
